headline: Iran War Odds Through 2026
status: Tracking runs to Dec. 31, where the odds are limited war 66%, escalated 13%, MOU-style 14% and comprehensive 7%. After a Democratic sweep in the midterms, Trump, who partly blamed the war and gas prices, says there is no immediate plan to strike Iran, so escalation odds ease and a thin deal gets likelier; the new Congress isn't seated until Jan. 3, and Tehran reads the vote as leverage, so a comprehensive deal doesn't move. The IRGC claims four tankers destroyed by mines and a US drone downed, but neither claim is confirmed, so no tripwire fires.

bets.cond: Iran accepts US sequencing, or round two is set with text
Iran ends strait tolls and permits, or declares Hormuz open to all shipping
Iran offers a concrete cut in enrichment capacity, in text or on the record
